messages:
maria: Heads-up — webinar 'Scaling LLM inference' next Wed 10am PT. We need X and LinkedIn posts + a threaded X narrative that highlights the benchmark story and the signup CTA. Can we lock hero image, 3 caption variants, and the benchmark blurb by EOD Fri? Figma: https://figma.com/file/abc123/webinar-assets :rocket:

devon: Got it. Can you confirm the hero size for X vs LinkedIn? Also want to confirm UTM params (utm_source=org-social, utm_campaign=llm-scale-webinar?)

maria: X hero should be 1600x900, LinkedIn 1200x627. UTM looks good — add utm_medium=social. I'll update the brief in figma + drop a 1-pager with the benchmark numbers.

devon: Working on 3 caption variants. Drafts below — feedback pls:
1) Live demo + benchmarks — join Wed 10am PT. Sign up: https://redwood.ai/webinar?utm_source=org-social :eyes:
2) How we cut per-token cost by 30% while holding latency — live walk-through. RSVP: <link>
3) Engineering playbook for predictable LLM inference — demo + Q&A. Register: <link>

sam: Quick routing check — how should inbound signups be routed? Current flow sends webinar leads to growth-sdr queue. Do we want a separate nurture stream for Dedicated interest?

jordan: Recommend splitting: Growth-SDR for general signups, Dedicated-interest tag -> routed to enterprise SDRs. Add form field checkboxes for "Dedicated capacity" so we can auto-tag.

maria: Good call. @devon can we add an extra hidden field in the registration URL to capture "dedicated_interest=1" for the targeted CTA link?

devon: Yup — I'll append &dedicated_interest=1 to variant #2 CTA. Also preparing the benchmark blurb for the thread: "We reduced 95th P90 latency by 18% and per-token cost by 31% on typical chat load via batching + KV caching." Want a shorter one-liner?

maria: Short one-liner for X thread: "18% lower tail latency, 31% cost savings — see how we did it. Wed 10am PT. RSVP: <link>"

devon: Scheduling plan — propose:
- X single post (day before) 11am PT
- X threaded preview (3 tweets) day-of 9am PT -> live CTA at 9:45am PT
- LinkedIn post (long copy + CTA) day-of 8am PT

ops-bot: Scheduled posts queued:
```
platform: x
post_time: 1715238000
content_id: 987654
status: queued
```

jordan: Follow-up cadence suggestion: send a post 2 days after with recording + TL;DR + 1 highlighted benchmark + CTA to request Dedicated eval. Add a comment CTA for community engagement.

sam: I'll update the nurture flow: webhook -> growth-sdr queue, tag -> enterprise-sdr if dedicated_interest=1. Also create an automation to send recording + resource pack to all registrants 24h after.

maria: Perfect. Last asks: devon, attach hero variations to figma and drop final captions by Fri 5pm. I'll approve and lock the schedule after that. Thanks all :thumbsup:
